description.content: Browse published products and prepare an interest list to request information.

commerce_catalog_meta_description.text: Browse products, availability and features before preparing your information request.

commerce_inquiry_meta_description.text: Review the selected products and send a single information request.

moduleH1Type01_00_p01_text.text: Browse available products and open each page to review its information before adding it to your interest list.

moduleH1Type01_00_p02_text.text: You can collect several products and send a single information request.

moduleH1Type01_01_p01_text.text: Review the description, availability and features of this product.

moduleH1Type01_01_p02_text.text: Add it to your interest list to request information with other products.

moduleH1Type01_02_p01_text.text: Review the selected products and complete your contact details.

moduleH1Type01_02_p02_text.text: You will receive a copy of the request and the responsible team can reply to you.

commerce_catalog_intro.text: Browse the catalog and collect the products you want to ask about in a single information request.

commerce_interest_added_status.text: Product added to the interest list.

commerce_interest_removed_status.text: Product removed from the interest list.

commerce_catalog_empty.text: There are no products available at this time.
